_about: Module definitions for the processing group (A4, A5; recut in A9). See logistics.json for the shape. Machines (layer `machine`: Press, Heater, Chiller, Blender) plug into a base's socket and act on its contents; interior strips (layer `interior`: Sieve, Macerator, Electrolyser, Heat Dispersal Unit) join a base on each pixel face and work on what passes between them. Strips name their faces `in` and `out` (the HDU `a` and `b`; the Electrolyser has a third, `gas`). `front` is where a Macerator's mouth and a Press's or Caster's block are. The Heater and Chiller share the thermal kind: `params.modes` lists {name, target (degrees), lets (what may leave the base while it is on), tech}, rate (degrees a scan), power (a second while it works). The Sieve is the strip kind: `params.rule` is a `pass` style filter. The Centrifuge and Caster are still chambers fed by a Tank's pass rule (separator and caster kinds).

modules.name: Macerator
modules.blurb: A strip between two bases. Grinds solid cells the base on its in side holds, and loose rigid bodies (a collapsed slab, a Press's block) that touch its open top, into powder for the base on its out side: Stone becomes Rubble. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power per cell.

modules.name: Press
modules.blurb: Plugs into the side of a Tank or Case, on either of its sides. Powder in its base is squeezed, once there is enough of one kind, into a solid block (a rigid body) that comes out of its top: Rubble becomes Stone, Loose dirt becomes Dirt. Its base keeps that powder in while it is there. Each block takes 3 seconds and some power, and needs open air above for the block.

modules.name: Heater
modules.blurb: Plugs into either side of a Tank or Case (a part with a plug on each side can sit between two bases and works on the first) and heats what the base holds. On Boil it holds 130 degrees: Water becomes Steam and only the gas leaves the base, with the Salt or Pitch the boiling leaves behind. With Smelting researched, a click sets it to Smelt at 950 degrees: Sand fuses to Glass, Ferrite or Veinstone with Flux smelts to Slag and Ferrite bars or Wire, and only those leave. Everything else stays in to cook. Smelt wants a Case, whose wall stands the heat. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power while it heats.

modules.name: Chiller
modules.blurb: Plugs into the side of a Tank or Case and cools what the base holds to 20 below zero, so Water freezes to Ice and Brine turns to Chillant. Only Ice and Chillant leave the base. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power while it cools.

modules.name: Caster
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Liquid joined into its bottom face is set, once there is enough of one kind, into a solid block (a rigid body) that comes out of its side: Lava becomes Obsidian, Slag a crust, Quickmire Mire stone, Water Ice. Each block takes 4 seconds and some power, and needs open air in front for the block.

modules.name: Electrolyser
modules.blurb: A strip between two bases, with a third on top for the gases. Splits what the base on its in side holds, for power a cell from a Node or the Hub in reach: two cells of Brine become two Lye, a Chlor and a Lift, and a cell of Water becomes a Lift (the oxygen vents). The Lye goes into the base on its out side and the gases into the base on top. Kept apart, because Lye and Chlor eat each other. Brine and Water wait in the first base until they are split.

modules.name: Sieve
modules.blurb: A strip between two bases. Liquids and gases pass from the base on its in side into the base on its out side; solids (powder and rock) stay where they are. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and a little power a cell.

modules.name: Centrifuge
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. A Tank passes a mix into its bottom face; it spins the mix apart by density, the lightest material out of its top face and the densest out of its left face, one material at a time. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power a cell.

modules.name: Blender
modules.blurb: Plugs into the side of a Tank or Case and stirs what the base holds until the materials lie mixed through it, so alloys form where layers would not. It stirs when a new material arrives and a Heater on the same base waits until it has finished. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power while it stirs.

modules.name: Heat Dispersal Unit
modules.blurb: A strip between two bases that carries heat from the hotter one to the cooler until their loads sit at the same temperature. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and a little power while it moves heat.
